cuts.head: with_body
cuts.placeText: a jewelry appraisal room — a velvet-topped table, a lamp with a magnifier, small trays of loose stones and a safe in the corner
cuts.scene: she is an appraiser leaning over the table with both hands holding a cut gemstone to the lamp
cuts.outfit: a gem appraiser look fitted to her body — a fitted sleeveless blouse and short pencil skirt with a gem-trim belt, bare arms and legs, a loupe hung on a chain
